summary: Skyline Builders Group (SKBL) and Cove Kaz Capital Group announced a Transaction Agreement for a business combination via a 6-K filing on April 30, 2026. Under the deal, SKBL will acquire Cove Kaz, which will become Kaz Resources Inc. listed on Nasdaq under KAZR. Cove Kaz holds critical minerals projects in Kazakhstan including tungsten. The combined company will also acquire Kaz Critical Minerals LLP with 15 licenses. Boards of both companies approved. EXIM and DFC issued Letters of Interest for up to $1.6B financing. Expected to close Q4 2026/early 2027 pending shareholder approval, regulatory nods, and SEC effectiveness. Watch for registration statement filings and financing milestones.
